family: Legacy MVP, rewind, and causal suites
research_question_and_protocol: Does routing history affect sparse MoE expert masks, ticket recovery, and specialization? Distinct historical TinyStories, WikiText-103, and multi-domain protocols include learned, fixed-random, random-every-step, replay, swap, shuffled-usage, strong-balance, pruning, and rewind conditions.
architectures_seeds_sparsities_router_st: Mostly 4/8/16 experts, top-1/top-2, 4/8 layers; three seeds in the summarized suites; sparsities and rewind points vary by experiment.
completion_and_controls: Reported complete in results/project_summary_so_far.md and results/execution_plan_1_results.md. Random routing, usage-shuffle, replay/swap, random-mask, random-reinit, and dense controls exist, but are not all shared across families.
available_artifacts_and_raw_measurements: Historical run reports, configs, checkpoints, route logs, masks, curves, and summaries; several paths named by old summaries are absent or superseded locally.
data_split_and_prior_use: Dataset-specific train/validation/test protocols vary. Historical test metrics must not be pooled with current Dataset A/B validation endpoints.
independent_unit: Training/source seed within each named protocol; token, expert, and checkpoint rows are not independent.
audits_superseded_reports_and_limitation: The root README and July 2026 project summary describe earlier scopes. Keep this family separate from current Dataset A/B and later router-age/IMP protocols. Representative expert-local IMP underperformed one-shot plus rewind in the legacy 8E cell.

research_question_and_protocol: How does sparse-minus-dense endpoint performance vary with selected router age, expert count, and pruning level under a fixed attempted-step budget? One-shot expert-local magnitude mask from source R100; experts/shared rewind to source R0; router is selected source age and is trainable during recovery.
architectures_seeds_sparsities_router_st: 8/12/16/24/32E; seeds 7/17/29/43/61; ages R0-R100 every 10%; target expert-weight sparsities 70/75/80/85/90/95%; 2500 attempted source and recovery updates.
completion_and_controls: Complete: 25 sources, 275 dense recoveries, 1650 sparse recoveries; 30 complete five-seed architecture/sparsity curves. Dense recovery is matched by seed and router age; mask is reused across router-age variants.
available_artifacts_and_raw_measurements: Frozen manifest, source/recovery/mask manifests, canonical CSV/Parquet, 50-step trajectories, checkpoint manifests, masks/checkpoints, exposure and optimizer audits, seed-winner and age summaries.
data_split_and_prior_use: Training and validation streams are hashed and matched within source seed. Validation endpoints are repeatedly used for selection; no untouched test set is established.
independent_unit: Five source seeds. The 11 ages and six sparsities within seed are repeated conditions, not independent replicates.
audits_superseded_reports_and_limitation: results/final_dataset_a/reports/dataset_a_final_analysis.md and its audits validate all expected cells, masks, ticket gaps, and protocol fields. Historical incompatible candidates are excluded. Source exposure uses sampled/proposed counts in places; accepted full source exposure and applied source updates are not universally available.

research_question_and_protocol: At 50-65% expert-local sparsity, how do age-conditioned gaps change across the same architecture/seed grid? Same source and recovery construction as Dataset A, extended to four lower sparsity settings.
architectures_seeds_sparsities_router_st: 8/12/16/24/32E; same five seeds; R0-R100 every 10%; 50/55/60/65% target sparsity; 2500 source and recovery attempts.
completion_and_controls: Complete: 220 settings x five seeds = 1100 paired sparse/dense endpoint cells. Dense controls are age/seed matched. No all-five-seed strict-match setting.

data_split_and_prior_use: Train/validation; repeated validation selection, no verified untouched test set. Lower-grid winner scans are exploratory and multiplicity-adjusted results are explicitly reported.
independent_unit: Five source seeds; ages and sparsities are repeated within source seed.
audits_superseded_reports_and_limitation: results/dataset_a_full_lower_sparsity/analysis_final/audit_report.md and scientific_interpretation.md preserve 212/1100 strict endpoint matches, no 5/5 setting, positive architecture marginal means, and selected-cell caveats. These data are not independent confirmation of Dataset A core.

The 66-74 GPU-hour estimate and storage estimate cover the original full planned new workload, not a measured remaining-work estimate.

R0 is full expert/shared initialization rewind; R10-R90 are hybrid starts with original experts/shared and a developed router; R100 uses source-final router.

completion_and_controls: Dataset A complete. E16 seed-7 exact repeat is not an independent seed; E24/E32 localization uses three seeds. No mechanistic intervention in the age-mapping workflow.

family: Iterative magnitude pruning (IMP) discovery and one-shot comparison
research_question_and_protocol: Does repeated prune/train/reset discovery create better expert-local tickets than one-shot pruning? IMP uses nested expert-local fc1/fc2 masks, nine 2500-attempt discovery stages through 80/85%, then separately trained final masks/recoveries from R0.
architectures_seeds_sparsities_router_st: Prepared 8/16/32E; seeds 7/17; 80/85%. Historical representative legacy IMP is a different 8E/top-1/4-layer/multi-domain protocol.
completion_and_controls: The new 25-group, 80/85% IMP workflow is prepared and preflighted but not launched. Do not call prepared masks/empty result files outcomes. A separate legacy representative IMP completed and was worse than one-shot/rewind under its own protocol.
available_artifacts_and_raw_measurements: scripts/imp_80_85 runner, preflight/checkpoint manifests, deterministic mask logic and test suite; legacy report in results/project_summary_so_far.md summarizes the distinct representative IMP.
data_split_and_prior_use: Train and validation are hash-checked in the prepared workflow; no test evaluation planned during discovery. Legacy multi-domain data differs from current Dataset A.
independent_unit: Source seed; no source-seed expansion in the prepared grid.
audits_superseded_reports_and_limitation: results/imp_80_85/README.md: 225 discovery stages plus 50 final recoveries, 687,500 attempted updates, estimated 670+ GPU-hours under provisional assumptions. Iterative discovery is not one-shot pruning, and rounds are not equivalent to one 2500-step mask recovery.

audits_superseded_reports_and_limitation: Critical compatibility distinction: fresh AdamW and GradScaler at step 2500 for sparse and dense, not exact optimizer continuation. Segment reset and moving dense references are documented in the README and high-sparsity protocol. Do not infer missing cells from documentation.
